title: Flat-map length bound
statement: Let $f$ map elements of a type $\alpha$ to finite lists over a type $\beta$, let $a\in\alpha$, and let $l$ be a finite list of elements of $\alpha$. If $a$ occurs in $l$, then the length of $f(a)$ is at most the length of the list obtained by concatenating $f(x)$ over all entries $x$ of $l$.
hypotheses_covered: $l$ is a finite list of elements of $\alpha$
